notes.title: Clive 'N' Wrench Update! Patch v1.1.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35135724/1deddbbda47ba52edb78f278b756e33b552e0d73.png[/img]

Hi everyone,
A big thanks to all of you that have played Clive 'N' Wrench thus far! It's been a blast seeing so many of you discovering the game for the first time.

[b]Changes include:[/b]
- Fixed a bug that could cause Clive to get stuck in a ledge grab.
- Re-enabled the erroneously disabled lighting in 'Cajun Mob Bog'.
- Increased the speed of the camera's analog stick movement (with hope to add sliders in the future).
- Removed some collision in 2D sections of 'Bluebeard's Gauntlet', that players could bump their heads on.
- Fixed prop pop-in that could occur in The Chimp The Bag & The Bunny.
- Fixed flickering lights when too many were on screen at once in some areas.
- Added penguins holding "duck" signs to Droo the Ripper's boss fight to remind players of the move, and establish they can duck his scissor throws.
- Added the ability to return to the main menu from the hub.
- Fixed misaligned images in the credits.
- Enabled v-sync, as uncapped frames were causing issues on higher end hardware (with hope to add a toggle in the future).

[b]We will be continuing to address feedback with ongoing patches.[/b]
